title: Correct transient registered observer bookkeeping and callback order
body: Since 50b3051, a mutation observer's node list only contains the nodes passed to observe(), but transient registered observers are added to nodes being removed. As a result, they were never removed: not when mutation observers are notified, not when observe() replaces the options of the registered observer they originate from, and not by disconnect(). In addition, since d34d52d, only mutation observers for which a record was queued are notified, so an observer that only got transient registered observers, e.g., one observing attributes with subtree when a child is removed, would not have them removed either. Track the nodes that have transient registered observers in a new transient node set and make the observer pending when a transient registered observer is added for it. This means that removing a node from an observed subtree queues the mutation observer microtask right away, which can be earlier than before, e.g., for replaceChildren(), as that queues its record after inserting the new children. Since d34d52d, mutation observers are notified in the order they became pending, which differs from implementations. Rather than changing that order in yet another way, notify mutation observers in the order they were created, as implementations do. This also: * Makes the original registered observer the source of a transient registered observer created from another transient registered observer, so that observe() removes those as well. * Makes observe() ignore transient registered observers when looking for an existing registered observer. Otherwise observing a node that was just removed from an observed subtree would modify its transient registered observer, which is removed the next time mutation observers are notified. * Avoids adding a transient registered observer to a node that already has one with the same source. * Makes the move algorithm add transient registered observers as well, as Chromium and Gecko do. * Makes queuing a mutation record only queue the mutation observer microtask if an observer gets a record, as implementations do. * Makes disconnect() empty the node list. This matches implementations, except that WebKit's moveBefore() does not add transient registered observers yet.
